capabilities: authorize to Yandex Wiki through a configured browser
browse the Yandex Wiki directory tree in a sidebar
export the whole vault or selected files to a chosen Wiki directory
display Yandex Wiki pages as HTML or Markdown
configure export formats and target slug in settings
disambiguation: The name suggests full wiki integration, but it currently only exports from Obsidian and displays Wiki pages; editing Wiki content is listed as a future plan.
extras: README warns that the optional session-saving mode stores credentials in local files and is unsafe; it also lists known bugs (e.g. right-click not working on some systems) and a roadmap of planned features like editing Wiki documents from the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish or export notes into a Yandex Wiki knowledge base.

relations.evidence: Плагин интеграции Obsidian с базой знаний Yandex Wiki.

requires.name: a Chromium-based browser (Yandex Browser, Chrome, or Edge)

summary: Integration plugin that logs into Yandex Wiki, browses its directory tree in a sidebar, and exports Obsidian vaults or files to it.
